issue: Entry not persisted after page reload
actual: Created entry "Test Validation Entry" with values (text: "Test Validation Entry", number: 5, date: "2026-09-15", checkbox: true) appears in table immediately. After page reload, entry count returns to 5 and the entry is no longer visible. Database evaluation confirms only original 5 entries remain.
evidence: Entry appeared immediately in table (6 entries total) but disappeared after reload (5 entries total)

Successfully created and saved entry with text "FT-3 Test Entry", number 3, date 2026-10-20, and unchecked checkbox. Values displayed correctly in both table view (formatted date "Oct 20, 2026") and card view. Checkbox state shows as "No" in both views and as X icon in table.

Successfully switched from table view to card view and back. All 6 entries remain visible with identical field values in both views. Entry "FT-3 Test Entry" with Priority 3, Due Date Oct 20, 2026, and Completed "No" displays in both views.

All entries display identically in table and card views: text values as-is, numbers as-is, dates formatted consistently ("Jan 15, 2026", "Oct 20, 2026"), and checkboxes shown with "Yes"/"No" text in cards and X/check icons in table. Empty checkbox shown as "No" with X icon.

Entry form displays type-appropriate controls: Task Name field uses textbox, Priority uses spinbutton (numeric only), Due Date uses date input (with calendar), Completed uses checkbox. All field types are clearly labeled with their names above the controls. Field configuration dialog also shows clear type labels (Text, Number, Date, Checkbox).

Checkbox states are clearly distinguishable: Checked state shows "Yes" in cards and check icon in table (with text-success class). Unchecked state shows "No" in cards and X icon in table (with text-muted-foreground class). Different visual indicators (icons and text) make states immediately clear.

Successfully sorted table view by Priority field in ascending then descending order. Entries reordered immediately (1,1,2,2,3,3 then 3,3,2,2,1,1). Switched to card view - sort was NOT applied (original order shown, Sort button shows "Sort"). Switched back to table - Priority descending sort still active. Confirms independent sort state per view.

Selected sort field "Priority" from menu - entries immediately reordered from original order to Priority 1,1,2,2,3,3 ascending. Active field identified by "Priority" button label in sort area and column header indicator. Direction shown in status "Sorted by Priority (ascending)". App remained fully usable during and after sort.

Before sort: 6 entries with specific values (Design new landing page/1/Jan 15, 2026, etc.). After sorting by Priority (ascending then descending): still 6 entries with identical field values, only order changed. All values intact: text, numbers, formatted dates, checkbox states unchanged.

Searched for "API" in search box - only "Update API documentation" entry displayed (1 entry matching "API"). Search matched text field value case-insensitively. Status updated to show "1 entry matching 'API'". Clicked clear button - all 6 entries restored, status shows "6 entries", search box empty.

Quick search for "API" matched the displayed text value "Update API documentation" in Task Name field. Search works on formatted/displayed values shown to users in the table view, not on raw internal values.

Successfully added 2 new fields: (1) "Notes" with Text type, (2) "Rating" with Number type. Both fields appeared immediately in table view with new column headers and "—" empty value representation. Both fields also appeared in card view with labels and "—" empty values. Field type dropdowns showed all 4 types available: Text, Number, Date, Checkbox.

Cleared the active Due Date sort by using "Clear sort" menu option. Status immediately changed from "Sorted by Due Date" to "Drag entries to reorder". Drag handles appeared in first cell of each row (circular icons). Drag-drop operation confirmed functional by status message "Draggable item entry-1 was dropped over droppable area entry-1".

Number fields (Priority and Rating) use HTML5 spinbutton input type which natively prevents non-numeric input at the browser level. The spinbutton element only accepts numeric values and prevents letters/special characters from being entered or saved.

Date field (Due Date) uses HTML5 date input type which natively validates and constrains input to valid calendar dates. The date input element only accepts dates in proper format and prevents invalid dates (e.g., Feb 30) from being entered or saved.
